## Key Points
Two of the big four artificial intelligence (AI) hyperscalers are **Amazon**( [AMZN](https://www.fool.com/quote/nasdaq/amzn/) +2.97%) and **Alphabet**( [GOOG](https://www.fool.com/quote/nasdaq/goog/) +3.60%)( [GOOGL](https://www.fool.com/quote/nasdaq/googl/) +3.15%).

## [NASDAQ: GOOGL](https://www.fool.com/quote/nasdaq/googl/)
### Key Data Points
60.43%

## Solid top- and bottom-line growth
Analysts expect 15% growth for Amazon in 2026, and 13% next year. Clearly, Alphabet takes the prize here.

## Both companies trade at a premium
However, with Alphabet's faster growth rate and cheaper stock price, [I think it's the better buy now](https://www.fool.com/investing/how-to-invest/stocks/how-to-invest-in-google-stock/).

web.description:
# The $530 Billion AI Question: Which Big Tech Stock is Winning?
## Google ($GOOGL): Record 83% Capex Surge to Scale Search and Google Cloud Momentum
Google signed a [deal with Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/news/expanding-our-use-of-google-cloud-tpus-and-services) in October said to be worth tens of billions, giving the Claude parent access to up to one million TPUs, bringing more than 1GW of capacity online in 2026.

The company’s capex grew by 83% YoY to $23.95 billion. Sequentially, it grew by 7% from $22.4 billion in the previous quarter.

It represents YoY growth of 75% at the midpoint.

## Amazon ($AMZN): AWS Reported the Fastest Growth since Q4 2022
This would represent 8–10% of AWS’ TTM revenue.

Amazon’s capex in Q3 rose 55% YoY to $35.1 billion, with the company [raising the 2025 capex guidance to $125 billion](https://seekingalpha.com/article/4835958-amazon-com-inc-amzn-q3-2025-earnings-call-transcript), up 51% YoY.
